name: Mayfair House Hotel & Garden
positioning: Colorful, art-filled hotel with a rooftop pool in Miami's Coconut Grove neighborhood
best_for: Travelers who want a Coconut Grove base away from South Beach
Guests who like individually distinct rooms and suites with clawfoot tubs and handcrafted furnishings
Active travelers who enjoy rooftop yoga and exploring by bike

facts.text: The hotel is in Miami's Coconut Grove neighborhood, Miami's original artist colony.
Coconut Grove is the oldest continuously inhabited neighborhood in Miami, with Bahamian roots.
The hotel's original architect was Kenneth Treister.
Mayfair House Hotel & Garden is included on Conde Nast Traveler's 2026 Gold List.
The guest rooms are pet-friendly and individually distinct, with handcrafted furnishings, upscale bathrooms and an art collection curated over the hotel's days as a Coconut Grove icon.
Deluxe Eden Studios are open-concept, with handcrafted furnishings, dining areas and clawfoot bathtubs.
Premium Suites have a queen-sized sleeper sectional sofa for two extra guests.
Dining venues are Mayfair Grill, the rooftop Sipsip and Fountain Lounge.
Fountain Lounge is set amid lush gardens and water features and serves creative cocktails.
Sunrise Vinyasa yoga on the rooftop, in partnership with OM Movement Studio, is complimentary for overnight guests.
Every guest is welcomed with a wellness shot from Coconut Grove's Juicence Juice & Smoothie Bar.
Guests can ride complimentary bikes along three curated bike routes to discover the Grove's green spaces.

highlights.text: The Mayfair Penthouse is an indoor/outdoor suite with a clawfoot bathtub, a wet bar and an original piano.
Grand Luxe Corner Suites have a clawfoot bathtub, a separate parlor, a mahogany desk and a vintage typewriter.
The rooftop pool has daybeds and island flavors from Sipsip Rum Bar, and a fireplace comes to life as the sun sets.
Guests can set out on a walking tour of other works by the hotel's original architect, Kenneth Treister, including Mayfair Mall, Elizabeth Virrick Park and Yacht Harbor Condominiums.
Guests can rent the hotel's customized classic 1950s British open-air Moke for local adventures and beach days.

considerations.text: The hotel charges a destination fee, which covers rooftop pool access, high-speed wireless internet, daily bike use, the 24-hour fitness center and daily sunrise yoga.
The rooftop hosts Sipsip Sun Club, a weekly Sunday pool party with a live DJ set.
WhataHotel notes the smaller property size may feel restrictive for extended stays.
